Welcome To Abbot’s Way School
Abbot's Way is a specialist day school for students aged 7 upwards
A warm welcome to Abbot’s Way School, our fresh, forward thinking independent specialist day school, for students with specific learning differences, such as dyslexia, dyspraxia, dyscalculia and dysgraphia.
Situated in the historic Somerset village of Meare, near Glastonbury, our school enjoys stunning, panoramic views of the Mendip hills and indeed the ancient Abbot’s Way track across the Somerset Levels, symbolising the pathway between two islands.
We hold a passion for specialist education and the highest aspiration for our students. The quality, enriched and holistic provision at Abbot's Way enables students to access individually tailored learning to fit their specific profile, in order to excel and achieve their personal potential, both academically and pastorally.
Students with specific learning differences are exceptional young people, with immense 'brilliance' and talent. They deserve the very best education where strengths are recognised and challenges are expertly understood and supported so that a student is not held back, but accelerated toward their potential.
At Abbot's Way our team of outstanding professionals work in harmony to discover, foster and develop young peoples’ strengths, enabling them to gain the self-belief and self-esteem they require, in order to make progress, flourish and thrive.

pageCache.pageTitle: Abbot's Way School Mission Aims and Values
pageCache.text:
Mission, Aims and Values
Our Mission
Abbot’s Way School's mission is to provide an exemplary holistic, specialist education for students with dyslexia, dyspraxia, dyscalculia and associated needs, so that all students achieve their own personal potential, both academically and pastorally .
School Aims
to provide an inspiring, accessible and challenging curriculum which encourages exploration, discovery and a lifelong love of learning.
to develop self-esteem, self-belief and confidence in every young person by fostering and celebrating their strengths, whilst supporting specific areas of challenge, in order that they thrive and achieve their potential.
to uphold and promote our vision, mission and values, in order to assure our unique ethos and aspiration for excellence.
School Values
We have 4 cornerstone values, which reflect the qualities and expectations which underpin our aspirations for every Abbot’s Way student.
These are also the values which our staff team commit to upholding and role modelling.
Honesty /ˈɒnɪsti/ Be trustworthy, loyal, fair, and sincere to others, and to yourself.
Kindness /ˈkʌɪn(d)nəs/ Be friendly, generous, and considerate towards others.
Courage /ˈkʌrɪdʒ/ Try to overcome fear and have the ability to do something that frightens you, be brave.
Endeavour /ɪnˈdɛvə,ɛnˈdɛvə/ Try hard to do or achieve something, attempt to achieve a goal with your very best efforts.
